answer: Each identity binds a private ferrous seed to a non-shareable walnut nonce%2C then must wander a sequential memory-hard path whose checkpoints are keyed to that pair. A farm of 500 clones must execute 500 independent serial walks%3B the walks cannot be parallelized across clones%2C so wall-clock cost scales linearly with head count while honest agents pay only one walk. Shared-nonce collisions slash both parties.
